hero_subtitle: Choose the plan that fits the size and needs of your veterinary clinic
plan_free_description: Ideal for small clinics or getting started at no cost.
plan_free_feature3: Limited number of clinical records per month
plan_free_feature4: Appointments, invoicing, and payments with monthly limits
plan_free_feature5: Basic data import and limited image storage
plan_basic_description: For growing clinics that need more capacity.
plan_basic_feature2: Increased number of clinical records available per month
plan_basic_feature3: Appointments, invoicing, and payments with higher limits
plan_basic_feature4: Improved import and more image storage
plan_pro_description: For professional clinics with advanced needs.
plan_pro_feature2: Higher number of clinical records per month
plan_pro_feature3: Unlimited appointments and payments, high-limit invoicing
plan_pro_feature4: Concurrent imports and expanded image storage
plan_enterprise_description: For large clinics or unlimited requirements.
plan_enterprise_feature3: Everything unlimited: appointments, invoicing, payments, and more
plan_enterprise_feature4: Priority support, unlimited imports, and maximum storage
closing_message: Only 1 workspace is allowed per account/user, regardless of the selected plan. Check and configure your plans, limits, and memberships within your workspace.
